title: Create e-commerce website with product filtering

requirements.text: Create a product catalog display showing multiple products with images, names, prices, and brief descriptions in a grid layout
acceptanceCriteria: Products are displayed in a responsive grid layout
Each product card shows an image, name, price, and description
Layout adapts to different screen sizes

requirements.text: Implement a filtering sidebar with options for category, price range, and rating to help shoppers make quick decisions

quotes: Online shoppers require product filtering options to make quick decisions

acceptanceCriteria: Filtering sidebar is visible and accessible
Users can filter by category using checkboxes or buttons
Users can filter by price range using a slider or input fields
Users can filter by rating selection
Product grid updates immediately when filters are applied

requirements.text: Create a backend product data model with fields for name, description, price, category, rating, and image URL
acceptanceCriteria: Product type includes all necessary fields
Products can be stored and retrieved
Data model supports filtering operations

requirements.text: Implement backend query methods to retrieve products filtered by category, price range, and rating
acceptanceCriteria: Query method accepts filter parameters
Returns only products matching all applied filters
Handles edge cases when no filters are applied

requirements.text: Seed the application with sample product data covering multiple categories and price ranges for demonstration
acceptanceCriteria: At least 15-20 sample products are pre-loaded
Products span multiple categories
Products have varied price points and ratings

requirements.text: Apply a modern, clean visual design theme with a professional e-commerce aesthetic, featuring neutral tones with accent colors, clear typography for product information, and intuitive interaction patterns for filtering and browsing
acceptanceCriteria: Visual theme is consistently applied across all pages
Color scheme supports readability and hierarchy
Typography is clear and appropriate for product information
Interactive elements have clear hover and active states

constraints: Use only Motoko for backend implementation
Use React with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS for frontend

required: Modern e-commerce hero banner with shopping theme, clean and professional (hero-banner.dim_1200x400.png)
Product placeholder image for electronics category item (product-electronics.dim_400x400.png)
Product placeholder image for clothing category item (product-clothing.dim_400x400.png)
Product placeholder image for home goods category item (product-home.dim_400x400.png)
Product placeholder image for books category item (product-books.dim_400x400.png)
